So I'm getting ready to get there and I get messages from a good amount of my friends saying, they couldn't get into the room. When I get there, the girls I was with (girl friends of the guys who paid for my table) couldn't get into the room! I was livid. I didn't understand what was going on so I talked to Stacey at the hostess stand. She was really helpful I give her a 5 rating. She helped us out and let us know what was going on. At the end of the night, I was charged and excess $168 on my card. I didn't understand and so the server brought out the manager. He asked us what was wrong and I told him that I was over charged for my table. I understand if she added the auto gratuity because we had a large party but 30% on 225 is not $100 over. He then told us that the Grey Goose bottle was $225 instead of the $175 I was quoted for. I got on my phone and showed him my e-mail and all he could say was that it probably showed up wrong on my e-mail or something. I was so livid! I know it wasn't that much extra money, but money is money! We all spent well over $800 that night. And then to top if off, he said I was incoherent and too drunk to know what I was talking about. I was coherent enough to pull up my e-mail, show him how much everything was quoted for, do the math and apparently I am the one who didn't understand. I understood that my table was supposed to be $175 with the admissions of 5 guys totaling $225 plus the gratuity, making the table no more than $295. I used to really love Mai, but I will NEVER get another table there. So next time you think about getting a table, just a heads up, they will screw you over. Happy Birthday to me....

text: I went to Avalon the first time last fall using a Groupon and was very surprised that it was as good as it was, this has not been the case with most of my Groupon deal restaurants in the past for some reason. Anyway...I can't remember exactly what I got but I know it was a pasta with short ribs, maybe a ravioli filled with short ribs, well whatever it was it was really amazing and left an impression. Last night (Friday) my boyfriend and I decided at the last min. to have dinner in west Chester. I remembered this place and decided to try it again. We were able to get in and both of us got the 4 course tasting menu for $40. FYI You can only get if both parties at the table get it, I guess they don't want 2 people sharing one. For the 1st dish by boyfriend had the Bruschetta with Prosciutto, Crab Apple Mostardo & Ricotta - Yum, the flavors worked so well together. I had the baby Arugula salad - nice. 2nd dish he had the TRUFFLED MUSHROOM TORTELLI with Herbed Mushroom Brodo which was really fantastic, full of flavor, my favorite for the evening. I got the BUTCHERS BOLOGNESE with Lamb, Pork, Veal, Beef, Pappardella, superb, very rich and velvety, this was my boyfriends favorite dish. For the 3rd I got the SCOTTISH SALMON with White Bean, Shrimp, Pancetta, & Spinach which is one of my favorite combos the inclusion of the shrimp was a surprise but it was all done to perfection and delish! My boyfriend had the fish of the day special, I think it was Halibut, I don't remember and didn't try it, he said is was "just so so". For dessert I had the bread pudding with choc. chips and cherries, so good, try it you won't be sorry. Bread pudding never sounds good but this was just really so well done. My boyfriend had had the hazelnut choc. crepes which were very good but as others said on the smaller side. I will say that the portions were a good size for a tasting menu, in fact more food than I could eat, but my honey didn't let anything go to waste. Our waitress was attentive but not overly so, and very knowledgeable with good suggestions. She, it turns out is one of the Chef/owner's daughters, we like her a lot. On the "could be improved list" the AC was a bit strong and it was a little chilly, but perhaps it was because there were only a few tables full and the impact of normal levels of body heat weren't present. We were there on a Fri night at 7:45 and with all the great reviews we weren't sure we could get in at the last minute because when I checked Open Table they said no resv. available??? I called directly and got one for inside but we would have rather have sat outside on the lovely patio however I was told we would have to wait 45 minutes. I peeked out there on the way to the ladies room and there were several open tables. Perhaps they were being held for later reservations, who knows , but it only cleared more before we left. It got busier inside though. Avalon is definitely a place I will return to, both visits so far were great and I especially like that it is a BYOB. I'm looking forward to patio next time. If you go remember your vino and that it is CASH only.
label: POS

text: Frozen yogurt is my thing, as those close to me know. Well, one of my myriad things, but my "dessert thing." You could even rock the bubble tea if you didn't feel in a froyo mood. My favorite combinations are coconut, Andes Mints, and blueberries. You wouldn't think it would work, but it does! Your standard candy toppings are here (Reese's, sprinkles, all that classic goodness) and there, it mingles with some exciting new friends like taro, pomegranate, and green tea powder. The most exciting part to me is that as a person who's slowly leaning into veganism, they have a soy yogurt option...in soft serve, no less. It's caramel every time I've been there and it does a body good. There's a nice little floating fruit wall in the back as well, so hey, individuality! It's in a strip mall with a solid Mexican restaurant and near a Thai place as well, so you'll be able to make a complete afternoon or evening meal out of it. Enjoy, kids!

text: We once had a rabbit called Cuddles. It can be difficult to find a vet who takes rabbits, but this vet embraces the traditional cats and dogs, and also rabbits and snakes. They offered to keep our rabbit there when we traveled (for a fee), and showed a love for Cuddles that seemed to border on our own affection. When we needed something explained, they did so gladly and in detail. They provided effective medication when Cuddles became infected in eyes and ear, and provided advice to us on how to extend our rabbit's life and general welfare. Whenever Cuddles developed a new way to frighten us, it was this crew that explained things to us and calmed us down. This same vet helped tactfully assist us in reaching the right decision when Cuddles health began to fail. When things reached their inevitable end, we took Cuddles to Riverbend Veterinary Clinic one final time, and if ever the team there had been understanding before, they were even more so now. Even though it was the right decision, it's the kind that always leaves you conflicted. But there's one thing I'm not conflicted about - Riverbend Veterinary Clinic will give your pet the care it deserves, and I fully recommend it.
